name: wj-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins of Wilfried JEANNIARD.

plugins.name: wj
plugins.description: Skills to work on an issue in its own worktree and VS Code window, and to lint the Markdown files of a repository.

plugins.name: wj-guard
plugins.description: Hook that refuses multi-line, compound, file-writing or inline-script Bash commands, and the forms that make Claude Code ask for a confirmation, and tells Claude how to rewrite them.

plugins.name: wj-behavior
plugins.description: Output style, applied whenever the plugin is enabled, that sets a lean working discipline: deliver only what is asked, in the simplest form, and ask when the request is ambiguous. Hook that refuses a commit whose message credits an AI tool as an author or holds an external reference.

plugins.name: wj-code-style
plugins.description: Hook that gives Claude the code-style rules at the start of every session: an exception never crosses a function or a method implicitly.
